༄༅/ /bla ma drag po'i sgrub thabs khyer bde bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// bla ma drag po'i sgrub thabs khyer bde bzhugs so//

khro bas khro ba 'dul ba'i phyir// drag po'i skur ston bla ma la// phyag byas de yi sgrub pa'i bcud// snying po'i yang gsang dril bar bya// rnal 'byor gyi yo byad rnams tshang bar bshams nas/ bde ba'i stan la 'dug ste/ hūm̐: mchog gsum 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid: bla ma rdo rje drag po rtsal: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad la: rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi: mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa: srid pa'i mtsho las yongs bsgral phyir: bla med byang chub mchog gi sems: dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi: hūm̐/ snang srid 'khor 'das chos rnams kun// stong nyid mtha' bral nam mkha'i dbyings// de las 'gag med snying rje'i rtsal// kun khyab mkha' la 'ja' shar ltar// stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa'i// rang rig 'gyur med thugs srog hūm̐// de las rim brtsegs 'byung lnga'i steng*// dur khrod rab 'jigs gzhal yas dbus// sde brgyad pad nyi srin po'i steng*// rang rig hūm̐ mtshan rdo rjer gyur// de nyid yongs gyur khro bo'i rgyal// 'jigs byed drag po thod phreng rtsal// zhal gcig phyag gnyis rngam brjid gzugs// dmar nag bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar// zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche ba gtsigs// dmar zlum spyan gsum sdang mig g.yo// phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje 'phyar// g.yon pas gnam lcags phur bu gzir// sdigs mdzub lcags sdig sprul pa 'gyed// dur khrod 'bar ba'i chas kyis spras// yum mchog rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// mthing nag gri thod 'dzin dang sbyor// thugs kar pad 'byung ye shes sems// de nang rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan// spyi bor bya khyung rigs bdag bzhugs// mtha' skor 'dab bzhir mkha' 'gro bzhi// rtsibs bzhir gsang bdag gshin rje gshed// rta mgrin me dbal rngam brjid tshul// kun kyang bskal me 'bar ba'i klong*/ khrag 'thung 'dus pa'i ngo bor bzhugs// gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan// 'od 'phros ye shes spyan drangs gyur// hūm̐/

o rgyan yul dang rnga yab gling*// laṅka dpal gyi pho brang nas// che mchog pad+ma drag po'i tshogs// spyan 'dren gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ hūm̐/ me tog la sogs phyi mchod dang*// 'dod yon sna lnga nang gi rdzas// bde stong sman raka gtor ma sogs// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul// sarba ma hā pū dza hoḥ hūm̐/ chos kyi dbyings las longs spyod rdzogs skur shar// bdud 'dul pad+ma 'byung gnas sprul pa'i sku /sku gsum bdag nyid dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso// mkha' ltar kun khyab khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng las// 'od 'phros stong gsum 'jig rten gang*// rgyal ba mchod cing byin rlabs bsdus// dregs pa tshar bcad nus mthu 'phrog /bdag thim che btsan zla bral gyur// gsang sngags rgyal po 'di nyid bzla/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ar tsig nir tsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ a hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ bdag gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig las/ 'od 'phros snang srid hūm̐ gis gang*// thams cad drag po'i ngar sgra sgrog /ma dag dngos 'dzin thams cad sbyangs// hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes pa'ang bzla'o// hūm̐/ chos nyid skye ba med pa las// 'gag med rdo rje srin por shar// 'gag pa nyid na 'gag med pa// spros bral ka dag klong du thim// zhes 1$0000250nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag go /slar yang dran rig ma hā gu ru'i skur langs 1$0000300 te spyod lam la 'jug go /tshul 'di theg mchog rdzogs chen snying po'i don// ji bzhin rtogs nas gzhan don phrin las can// grub pa'i rig 'dzin klong yangs 'od gsal gyis// 'gag med chu nang zla bzhin bskyed rdzogs kyis// rang nyid 'gal rkyen mi mthun g.yul ngo las// skyob phyir tshul 'di'i srung 'khor ra ba la// brtson pa'i rdo rje'i ri mo gsal ba na// 'gyur med rdo rjes gter tshig khrigs su bsdebs// maṅga laṃ//
